title: Register as an employer for the Community Services Industry portable long service leave scheme
summary: Find out how to register as an employer for the Community Services Industry portable long service leave scheme, which starts on 1 July 2025.
intro: The NSW Government is introducing a new Community Services Industry portable long service leave scheme on 1 July 2025. Levies and record-keeping responsibilities will only be calculated from 1 July 2025 onwards. Find out how the scheme works and what types of workers are eligible.
who_can_apply: Work to provide a community service.
Work for an employer whose predominant purpose is to provide a community service.
Employ one or more persons to do community service work.
Supply a person through a labour hire arrangement to do community service work.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to register for the scheme.

more_info.text: If you have multiple businesses, you will need to have separate ABNs for each application.
After your registration is received, it will be reviewed by Service NSW and you'll be notified of the outcome. This may take up to 5 business days.
Service NSW will provide registered businesses with details on how to take part in the scheme.
If you're applying on behalf of the business, the principal authority will have to accept or decline the application in the Business Profile before the registration is completed.

faqs.q: When does the Community Services Industry portable long service leave scheme start?
faqs.a: The scheme is introduced on 1 July 2025. Levies and record-keeping responsibilities will only be calculated from this date onwards.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to be an employer under this scheme?
faqs.a: Eligible employers are people who employ one or more persons to do community service work or supply a person through a labour hire arrangement to do community service work.

faqs.q: How do I register for the scheme?
faqs.a: Select the 'Start registration' button, log in (or create your MyServiceNSW Account), and follow the prompts to register for the scheme.
